headline: Ameriprise (AMP) Stock Looks Below Fair Value As Returns Stay Strong
summary: Ameriprise Financial stock has delivered a strong 121.8% return over the past five years, yet current valuation checks and an intrinsic value estimate based on the Excess Returns model both point to the shares trading at a discount to what the business may be worth. headline: Eight Ameriprise Financial Advisors Recognized on Barron’s "Top 100 Women Financial Advisors" Ranking
summary: MINNEAPOLIS, August 05, 2026--Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) today announced that eight of its financial advisors have been named to the Barron’s "Top 100 Women Financial Advisors" ranking, a prestigious industry list recognizing leading women financial advisors across the United States. The honored advisors exemplify Ameriprise's commitment to delivering personalized financial advice and helping clients achieve their financial goals with confidence.
